response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS group_amount FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT group_amount, 1.0 * group_amount / SUM(group_amount) OVER () AS share FROM grouped), compared AS (SELECT group_amount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(group_amount) AS total_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
